name: Open In
description: Open the current project folder in your installed editors, IDEs, terminals and file manager from the task header.
whenToUse: Use when the user wants to open the current task's project folder in VS Code, Cursor, another IDE, a terminal or the file manager. Local projects only; remote tasks are not supported.

list_apps.description: List installed apps on the executing computer that can open the project folder. Called only by the plugin menu page.

open_in.description: Open the task's project folder in a specified installed app. Called only by the plugin menu page.

/properties/app.title: App id
/properties/app.description: An app id returned by list_apps.

/properties/path.title: Project folder
/properties/path.description: Absolute path of the current task's project folder.
